newsitem.title: CANADA: T-D Bank cuts '96 loan loss provision.
newsitem.headline: T-D Bank cuts '96 loan loss provision.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Thursday that it reduced its 1996 provision for loan losses to C$152 million, down from C$180 million in 1995.

The final 1996 provision was also lower than the bank's C$170 million estimate in the prior third quarter. The bank's net impaired loans in the fourth quarter ended October 31 fell C$95 million to C$344 million.

"This decline was largely due to improvement in real estate loans to corporate borrowers," the bank said. Net impaired loans as a percentage of total loans and acceptances dropped to 0.4 percent at year end.
